name: NYC ZIP-code choropleth (MapLibre)
description: MapLibre + PMTiles choropleth at ZCTA (ZIP-code) resolution across the NYC metro. The previous Plot-based maps render TopoJSON to SVG — fast and projection-faithful for states and counties, but choking at the 33k-feature ZCTA level. This engine pre-bakes geometry into a PMTiles archive read over HTTP range requests and paints the fill on the GPU. Theme-driven: switching themes recolors the map without touching the tile.
